general_feeling: It was fine for one week, but I am glad I no longer have to wear them now. It was a bit of a nuisance, but also fun and meaningful to be part of this experiment.
challenges: Sometimes it was uncomfortable during certain activities. I normally do not wear glasses so it took some getting used to. Often had red marks on my nose at the end of the day. Uncomfortable while wearing headphones.
beh_adapt: Sometimes I wore the glasses on my forehead to avoid questions in shops for example. I acted normally most of the time, but it does take time to fill in the sheet all the time and to explain why to bystanders.
social: Non-stop. I think I told the story almost a 100 times during parties, in shops, on the streets, family, coworkers. People were always looking at me while walking or cycling, many people directly asked what it was for. Many thought I was filming them, including security at the cinema. Some people couldn't help laugh each time they saw me. Some said they would maybe do it for a 1000 euros, but not less.
improvements: Take out the bluetooth if you are not using it to make the sensor smaller. Smaller would be better if possible. After one week went from 4.16 volt to 3.99 volt, so you could make the battery smaller if measurements are just for one week.     But I get these are standardized and cheaper and multifunctional
change_behavior: I tried submitting answers that reflected how I felt, I did not want to obscure the results in any way.     I just lived as I normally would. I did go outside more often this weeek, but that's mostly because it was very sunny all week.
